description: This file is an upgrade controller script for Opencart, specifically implementing upgrade step 10. It performs database updates such as renaming paths, updating meta titles, fixing data structure issues, and cleaning up obsolete fields and tables during the upgrade process.

classes.name: Upgrade10
classes.description: A class extending the core Controller, responsible for executing database upgrades and category repairs as part of the upgrade process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: The main method executing database update queries, data migrations, and cleanup operations necessary for upgrade step 10.

methods.name: repairCategories
methods.description: A private method to repair and rebuild category paths in the nested set model.
